root_cause: The initial shared 500 ms p99 guardrail did not separate steady-state GPU candidate latency from single-node API replacement cost. Local image startup caused a bounded latency wave while preserving all logical effects. Prometheus was queried before the next file_sd scrape completed and transiently reported down even though it converged to up.
remediation: Freeze separate API rolling and GPU candidate p99 guardrails. The API limit is 2000 ms for the next fresh run; the GPU candidate limit remains 500 ms.
Measure Prometheus recovery from the first post-rollout observation until the exact target returns up instead of copying one instantaneous health sample.
Restart all three accepted API repetitions from a clean source revision; this attempt receives no acceptance credit.
claim_boundary: This failed local controlled attempt is retained as RCA evidence and provides no S6 acceptance credit.
